_doc: Single source of truth for scene timing + narration. scripts/tts.py reads this to synthesize public/audio/voiceover.wav and write src/narration.json (sentence/caption timings). Captions are the on-screen text; `tts` (optional) is what the voice reads when pronunciation differs.

sentences.text: AI systems increasingly depend on trusted knowledge.
captions: AI systems increasingly depend on trusted knowledge.

sentences.text: But what happens when that knowledge changes after it reaches your system?
captions: But what happens when that knowledge changes
after it reaches your system?

sentences.text: Istithbat separates what is newest from what is trusted — and what applications are actually allowed to serve.
sentences.tts: Istithbat separates what is newest from what is trusted, and what applications are actually allowed to serve.
captions: Istithbat separates what is newest from what is trusted —
and what applications are actually allowed to serve.

sentences.text: In this controlled demo, we start from a trusted baseline and publish one known mutation of real HadeethEnc record 10618.
sentences.tts: In this controlled demo, we start from a trusted baseline, and publish one known mutation of real HadeethEnc record, one zero six one eight.
captions: In this controlled demo, we start from a trusted baseline
and publish one known mutation
of real HadeethEnc record 10618.

sentences.text: Istithbat snapshots and fingerprints the source, detects the exact field change, analyzes its semantic significance, runs matched behavioral regression, traces downstream exposure, and evaluates deterministic policy.
captions: Istithbat snapshots and fingerprints the source,
detects the exact field change,
analyzes its semantic significance,
runs matched behavioral regression,
traces downstream exposure,
and evaluates deterministic policy.

sentences.text: The hadith text does not change.
captions: The hadith text does not change.

sentences.text: Only the grading field changes: an explicit exception disappears.
sentences.tts: Only the grading field changes. An explicit exception disappears.
captions: Only the grading field changes:
an explicit exception disappears.

sentences.text: The same model is then tested under matched conditions.
captions: The same model is then tested under matched conditions.
Only the knowledge version changes.

sentences.text: All three comparisons were classified materially different.
captions: All three comparisons were classified materially different.

sentences.text: Blast Radius deterministically traces where the change can travel.
captions: Blast Radius deterministically traces where the change can travel.

sentences.text: Six downstream assets are exposed, and one protected application shows material behavioral impact.
captions: Six downstream assets are exposed,
and one protected application shows material behavioral impact.

sentences.text: But impact does not become trust.
captions: But impact does not become trust.

sentences.text: POL-002 quarantines the candidate, while the previous trusted version continues serving without interruption.
sentences.tts: P O L zero zero two quarantines the candidate, while the previous trusted version continues serving without interruption.
captions: POL-002 quarantines the candidate,
while the previous trusted version continues serving without interruption.

sentences.text: The reviewer receives every evidence layer in one place.
captions: The reviewer receives every evidence layer in one place.

sentences.text: AI can raise concern, but it cannot promote knowledge or replace expert judgment.
captions: AI can raise concern, but it cannot promote knowledge
or replace expert judgment.
